terminological_phases.target_of_perturbation: Observation data noise: u_delta = u + delta u

terminology_evolution_and_invariance.underlying_invariant_structure: The epistemic question remains identical across 70 years: 'Does qualitative/quantitative structure survive perturbation in the presence of physical uncertainty?' Only the mathematical object subjected to perturbation varies (state -> vector field -> observation data).

terminological_phases.mathematical_mechanism: Linear and algebraic transformations mapping geometric paths to linear motion

terminological_phases.target_of_perturbation: Differential operator potential q(x) -> spectral measure
terminological_phases.mathematical_mechanism: Triangular Volterra integral operator I + K relating perturbed equation to unperturbed equation

terminological_phases.term: метод обратной задачи рассеяния / пары Лакса (Zakharov-Shabat, 1971)
terminological_phases.mathematical_mechanism: Associating nonlinear PDE with linear spectral operator L(u) whose eigenvalues are invariant integrals of motion

terminology_evolution_and_invariance.underlying_invariant_structure: Representing an intractable or inaccessible nonlinear interaction as a linear transformation operator acting on a known base system.

chronological_formulations_comparison.historical_verdict: Hadamard established diagnostic criteria classifying ill-posedness; Tikhonov systematically created constructive regularized approximation methods to solve them.

Different mathematical formulations for optimal control. Pontryagin's method directly accommodates closed control boundaries and bang-bang switching; immediately crossed borders into Western aerospace.

chronological_formulations_comparison.key_dates_comparison: Nyquist (1932) <-> Andronov (1937) -> Lefschetz English translation (1949) -> Smale (1960s)
chronological_formulations_comparison.historical_verdict: Andronov pioneered qualitative phase-space analysis of nonlinear limit cycles; Nyquist/Bode analyzed linear feedback frequency response. Both solve distinct engineering domains.

chronological_formulations_comparison.key_dates_comparison: Boltzmann (1896) -> Chapman-Cowling (1939) vs Vlasov (1938) -> Landau damping (1946)
chronological_formulations_comparison.historical_verdict: Vlasov established that long-range Coulomb interactions supersede Boltzmann's binary collision model in high-temperature plasmas, creating modern plasma kinetics.
Exemplary international mathematical synergy: US and Soviet mathematicians rapidly built on each other's inverse spectral results to formalize soliton integration.

chronological_formulations_comparison.alternative_tradition: Taylor Local Point Expansion (1715) & Runge Approximation
chronological_formulations_comparison.historical_verdict: Chebyshev established constructive approximation minimizing peak error over intervals, foundational for worldwide digital filter design and numerical software.
